summary: Verified Estimate/Quote full-CRUD + accepted-guard behavior on backend and Lead Detail UI. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passed via public preview URL. UI: on /leads/{id}, red trash delete-estimate-{id} buttons render for every estimate; delete-quote-{id} button renders ONLY for non-accepted quotes; UI delete flow (confirm dialog -> API -> toast -> row removed) works. Server-side guards return the expected status codes (409/400) for accepted quote and its estimate.
verified_behaviors: POST /api/estimates + GET/PUT/DELETE all 200 when no accepted quote exists.
DELETE /api/quotes/{id} on draft => 200; quote no longer returned by GET (404).
DELETE /api/estimates/{id} when estimate has accepted quote => 409.
PUT /api/estimates/{id} when estimate has accepted quote => 409.
UI: data-testid=delete-estimate-{id} present on all estimate rows (owner role).
UI: data-testid=delete-quote-{id} present ONLY when q.status !== 'accepted'; hidden on accepted QUO-0393.
UI: window.confirm dialog accepted, DELETE fires, 'Quote deleted' / 'Estimate deleted' toast, row disappears after load().
critical_code_review_comments: estimates.delete_estimate uses db.delete(e) which will ORM-cascade EstimateLineItem rows; ensure any non-accepted Quote rows referencing this estimate_id have ON DELETE SET NULL (or nullable FK) so the delete does not fail with FK violation when a draft quote was previously generated from the estimate. Worth adding an explicit test for 'delete estimate that has a non-accepted quote' (not covered by current review request but recommended).
quotes.delete_quote cascades packages/line items via ORM; confirm cascade is configured on relationships (verified indirectly: draft-quote delete succeeded).
Frontend LeadDetail.jsx uses window.confirm — acceptable for MVP, but a shadcn AlertDialog would improve consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created a property + lead + customer + 3 estimates + 2 quotes (1 draft, 1 accepted -> Job created). Lead id: 487c6557-a3ff-416e-b444-68b54e4f5096. UI deleted 1 estimate and 1 draft quote; the accepted quote + its estimate + created job remain (locked and cannot be cleaned up by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully working end-to-end. Suggested extension: test 'delete estimate that has a draft (non-accepted) quote' — spec says the draft quote should keep its snapshot (estimate_id set null). This edge case was NOT covered by the current review request.
